pages.title: Psycho Deep Fry
pages.text: Race 3: San Diego, 4.6 miles. Password: BEACH. The tune on top is not a guitar: it is the Mega Drive's PSG, the square-wave chip, in the Melody track. Skitchin' (EA, 1994), Mega Drive / Genesis. Music by Jeff van Dyck.

pages.title: Lead on the PSG
pages.text: Jeff wrote the lead guitar as a sample, but it did not fit next to the band, so it went to the PSG chip. That beepy lead, he says, is what makes the game sound 'Genesis'.

pages.title: Three at once
pages.text: The Mega Drive has one sample channel, and most games play one sample at a time. Kevin Pickell's EA sound driver mixed three on it, so a kick, a snare and a guitar can sound together.
